pool.text: Sweyn Forkbeard abandoned and burned Salisbury alongside Wilton.
A motte-and-bailey castle was constructed following the Norman invasion.
Herman became the first bishop of Salisbury via the Council of London.
The first Salisbury cathedral was consecrated before suffering storm damage.
New Sarum received its city charter near the river settlement.
St Edmund's was founded as a collegiate church in the city.
Salisbury bus station opened in Endless Street in the city.
Racehorse trainer David Elsworth was born in the city of Salisbury.
Violinist and conductor Iona Brown was born in the city of Salisbury.
Radio disc jockey Ray Teret was born in the city of Salisbury.
Classical music conductor Sir Jeffrey Tate was born in Salisbury.
Actor John Rhys-Davies, known for playing Gimli, was born in Salisbury.
Actor Anthony Daniels, famous for playing C-3PO, was born in Salisbury.
Pop and rock group Dave Dee, Dozy, Beaky, Mick and Tich formed.
Band Uriah Heep released an album and song called Salisbury.
Salisbury's annual International Arts Festival started to provide arts programmes.
Former Prime Minister Edward Heath began living at Arundells on Cathedral Green.
Salisbury has been twinned with Saintes, France.
The closure of the Friends Life office was announced.
Former Russian double agent Sergei Skripal was poisoned in Salisbury.
